## apiome help {#help}

Show concise usage, or ``--help`` for a subcommand.

```text
apiome help [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]...
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `COMMAND...` | text |  | Subcommand path (e.g. projects list, import openapi). |
